subject.title: Dashboard: control hub — per-agent nesting, shared/private tabs, presence

question: What stable identity and authorization contract should own private dashboard tabs across browsers, paired devices, CLI calls, and agent tools?
rationale: The current implementation keys gateway ownership to a device while CLI and agent-tool surfaces lack the same identity, so tests cannot decide the intended product security boundary.

options.title: Define operator identity first
options.body: Pause private tabs until one explicit per-human identity and authorization contract covers gateway, CLI, history, and agent-tool access.

options.title: Make privacy device-scoped
options.body: Document tabs as device-private and fail closed for every read, mutation, tool, and event without the owning paired-device identity.

options.title: Defer private tabs
options.body: Keep per-agent grouping and non-sensitive presence separate while moving private tabs into a dedicated security-reviewed change.

recommendation.title: Define operator identity first
recommendation.body: Pause private tabs until one explicit per-human identity and authorization contract covers gateway, CLI, history, and agent-tool access.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main bundled Control UI product pattern and adjacent ownership boundary were introduced in the Logbook work.
